reason: I already check Public every day and my broker is rolling out its own AI stuff for free, so I don't see why I'd pay another monthly fee for a cartoon pet to do what I already do in two taps. It's demo money today and the price isn't even set, so there's nothing concrete to sign up for.
objection: My broker already has free AI agents, and I'm not handing real money to a new app that doesn't have its broker partner or price nailed down yet.
would_change_my_mind: A named, licensed broker partner with SIPC coverage, and a track record showing the agent actually beat what I do myself after fees.
